This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.176/2022, registered at Police Station- Shyamlal Hills, District-Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 366-A, 376(2)(n), 109, 120-B &
368 of IPC r/w Sections 5, 6, 16 & 17 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for applicant submitted that as per prosecution story, main accused int he case Naveen was having love relationship with a muslim girl.
Said girl eloped along with applicant.
Applicant changed his religion and, thereafter, committed Nikah with muslim girl.

Allegations are also made against present applicant, who is sister of Naveen that she has also helped Sarika vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85544170/
1 them in the incident.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that applicant does not have any role in the incident and has been implicated only because she is sister of main accused-Naveen.
In view of same, applicant be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that prosecutrix in her statement has not stated anything about applicant but in 3rd statement, which has been recorded after period of 5-6 months, she had made allegations against present applicant Sarika and other members of family.
Prosecutrix is minor and is aged about 15 years and 10 months only.
It is submitted that in these circumstances, application for grant of anticipatory bail may be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Subsequent recording of statement influence over prosecutrix cannot be ruled out.
Prosecutrix is about 16 years of age and having sufficient maturity and understanding.
6 . Considering aforesaid, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the police in the aforesaid FIR, applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer)/trial Court for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during trial.

7. It is directed that applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
